entries.claim: After an initial full-phase pickup budget reached an open-hand approach, a further70-control authorization allowed sustained ungrasped retreat rather than descent. Prefer a30-control reassessment budget at an already-near-target but unverified approach, or one reviewed prefix for a known grasp recovery. This is conditional budget advice, not a universal duration or hard trust limit.
entries.conditions: ButtonUnmaskSwap container pickup when the current wrist view shows an open hand near the target but grasp/descent is not yet established, especially after a prior full-phase-sized authorization. In this run drift was clearly accumulating by534,20 controls after authorization514, but the exact earliest error frame is unresolved. A later bounded alignment plus reviewed VLA grasp/lift ended in official success; shorter-budget superiority was not experimentally tested. Do not reuse target coordinates, color locations or world-axis direction from this episode.

entries.claim: When switching from the second button to green-container pickup while the hand remains over the old button, do not treat an initially safe retract as sufficient evidence for a full approach budget. Review one candidate prefix, at most16 controls, and verify lateral transfer before authorizing ordinary pickup continuation. A measured gripper-opening guard cannot detect a repeated closed-hand button descent.
entries.conditions: ButtonUnmaskSwap second-button→green-pickup transition with the hand still over the previous button. entries.claim: In the first-to-second-button transition, neither a safe-looking retract nor a completed finite high lateral transfer is sufficient evidence for a long VLA authorization. Review one fresh candidate prefix (at most16 controls) when resuming VLA after old-target persistence, and verify sustained adherence to the new button before extending the interval. This revises the earlier transition advice to include post-transfer recovery, not only a hand still over the old button.
entries.conditions: ButtonUnmaskSwap second-button phase after observed old-target persistence. Earlier entry1f870 documented renewed old-button descent19 controls into a90-control authorization.
